summary_excerpts: ROK jumped 5.4% to $459.35 on NYSE after Q2 2026 earnings beat. Adjusted EPS $3.30 vs consensus $2.92. Revenue $2.24B vs expectations ~$2.18B.

Catalyst: converting strong orders in data centers, semiconductors, and energy into sustained higher margin growth. Demand strong in warehouse automation, data centers, semiconductors with double-digit growth.
Updated fiscal 2026 outlook: ~US$8.9 billion of revenue and higher EPS guidance, well ahead of analyst expectations.
